uncertainties.note: Source says only 'senpai' (先輩) with no name attached. Rendered as 'Focker' because the immediate reply in each case matches Focker's established brash, self-assured personality (character_names_021.json) and his role as Hikaru's/Dyson's senpai figure, consistent with the later exchange at 5306-5309 where Dyson explicitly calls Focker 'senpai'. No name is invented beyond this inference; flagged in case the orchestrator disagrees with substituting a name for a bare honorific.

'Misumaru no oyajisan' (ミスマルの親父さん) rendered 'old man Misumaru', read as an affectionate nickname for a commanding officer (Kouichiro Misumaru, Admiral/Londo Bell commander per meeting_terms_015.json) rather than a literal claim that Misumaru is anyone's father. Not asserted as fact beyond the source's own wording.
Speaker/addressee not identifiable from the surrounding rows (no color tags, no names). Kept neutral; no identity or gender assigned.

'Engokan' (援護艦, escort ship) and 'goeibutai' (護衛部隊, escort unit) are never named in these dialogue rows. hud_labels.json separately locks a 'Clop-class cruiser' warning for this same mission (resource block with 'Ghost sighted'/'Gekko' warnings), but since the dialogue text itself never names the ship, it was not matched to that HUD label here. Flagged in case the orchestrator wants the two linked explicitly.

'Gettomashin' (ゲットマシン) researched as 'Get Machine' (the individual jets that combine into Getter Robo; getterrobo.fandom.com). Not previously in the glossary; proposal filed. Speaker not identifiable among the Getter Robo cast members mixed into this mission.

Speaker of 5243/5245/5248 inferred as Isamu Dyson (confirmed by 5244 addressing him as 'Lieutenant Dyson'); Hikaru Ichijo inferred as the modest respondent in 5244/5246/5247. Consistent with both characters' glossary personalities (Dyson: reckless/carefree; Hikaru: happy-go-lucky, a bit clumsy) but not asserted beyond what the two-line exchange itself supports.
